note: A flat one unit on all qualifying games at final consensus price. Moneyline bets pay the same as the favorite's price generally -250 to -400. Spreads and totals pay at -110. There are no recommendations. It takes 40 to 80 graded games to get a verdict for each pattern. Verdict is calculated once.
upcoming_intro: Each selection is frozen the first time it triggers its pattern on a new line. The frozen line is what we are grading against. Next to the frozen line is the current line to give you an idea of what changed. If the line is over an hour old near kick off, no line will be shown as a pick. Watch is when the line changed significantly in the last two hours, and we are not sure why. No college football injury feed. Line is news.
howto_3: The graded line is the verified closing consensus line which is what you could have possibly received late as a bettor. It is not necessarily the best price of the week. The next table is what the best retail price was at the time of the selection freeze. It is not the line you will be graded on.
